    85→
    86→	// Verify shadow branch created with correct worktree-specific naming
    87→	expectedShadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(initialHead)
    88→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch) {
    89→		t.Errorf("Expected shadow branch %s to exist", expectedShadowBranch)
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	// Verify 1 rewind point
    93→	points := env.GetRewindPoints()
    94→	if len(points) != 1 {
    95→		t.Fatalf("Expected 1 rewind point after first checkpoint, got %d", len(points))
    96→	}
    97→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 1 created: %s", points[0].Message)
    98→
    99→	// ========================================
   100→	// Phase 3: Second Checkpoint (continuing same session)
   101→	// ========================================
   102→	t.Log("Phase 3: Creating second checkpoint (continuing same session)")
   103→
   104→	// Continue the same session (not a new session) - this is the expected Claude behavior
   105→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   106→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
   107→	}
   108→
   109→	// Create hash.go and modify auth.go
   110→	hashV1 := "package auth\n\nimport \"crypto/sha256\"\n\nfunc HashPassword(pass string) []byte {\n\th := sha256.Sum256([]byte(pass))\n\treturn h[:]\n}"
   111→	authV2 := "package auth\n\nfunc Authenticate(user, pass string) bool {\n\t// TODO: use hashed passwords\n\treturn false\n}"
   112→	env.WriteFile("src/hash.go", hashV1)
   113→	env.WriteFile("src/auth.go", authV2)
   114→
   115→	// Reset transcript builder for the new checkpoint
   116→	session.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   117→	session.CreateTranscript(
   118→		"Add password hashing",
   119→		[]FileChange{
   120→			{Path: "src/hash.go", Content: hashV1},
   121→			{Path: "src/auth.go", Content: authV2},
   122→		},
   123→	)
   124→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   125→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Verify 2 rewind points on same shadow branch
   129→	points = env.GetRewindPoints()
   130→	if len(points) != 2 {
   131→		t.Fatalf("Expected 2 rewind points after second checkpoint, got %d", len(points))
   132→	}
   133→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2 created: %s", points[0].Message)
   134→
   135→	// Verify both files exist
   136→	if !env.FileExists("src/hash.go") {
   137→		t.Error("src/hash.go should exist after checkpoint 2")
   138→	}
   139→	if content := env.ReadFile("src/auth.go"); content != authV2 {
   140→		t.Errorf("src/auth.go should have v2 content, got: %s", content)
   141→	}
   142→
   143→	// ========================================
   144→	// Phase 4: Rewind to First Checkpoint
   145→	// ========================================
   146→	t.Log("Phase 4: Rewinding to first checkpoint")
   147→
   148→	// Find checkpoint 1 by message (the one for "Create authentication module")
   149→	var checkpoint1ID string
   150→	for _, p := range points {
   151→		if p.Message == "Create authentication module" {
   152→			checkpoint1ID = p.ID
   153→			break
   154→		}
   155→	}
   156→	if checkpoint1ID == "" {
   157→		t.Fatalf("Could not find checkpoint for 'Create authentication module' in %d points", len(points))
   158→	}
   159→
   160→	if err := env.Rewind(checkpoint1ID); err != nil {
   161→		t.Fatalf("Rewind to checkpoint 1 failed: %v", err)
   162→	}
   163→
   164→	// Verify hash.go was removed (it was only added in checkpoint 2)
   165→	if env.FileExists("src/hash.go") {
   166→		t.Error("src/hash.go should NOT exist after rewind to checkpoint 1")
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Verify auth.go restored to v1 (without the "TODO: use hashed passwords" comment)
   170→	content := env.ReadFile("src/auth.go")
   171→	if content != authV1 {
   172→		t.Errorf("src/auth.go should be restored to v1 after rewind, got: %s", content)
   173→	}
   174→
   175→	// Verify HEAD unchanged (shadow doesn't modify user's branch)
   176→	if head := env.GetHeadHash(); head != initialHead {
   177→		t.Errorf("HEAD should be unchanged after rewind, got %s, want %s", head[:7], initialHead[:7])
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	// Verify shadow branch still exists (history preserved)
   181→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch) {
   182→		t.Errorf("Shadow branch %s should still exist after rewind", expectedShadowBranch)
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	// ========================================
   186→	// Phase 5: New Checkpoint After Rewind (continue same session)
   187→	// ========================================
   188→	t.Log("Phase 5: Creating checkpoint after rewind (continuing same session)")
   189→
   190→	// Continue the same session after rewind
   191→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   192→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (after rewind) failed: %v", err)
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	// Reset transcript builder for next checkpoint
   196→	session.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   197→
   198→	// Create bcrypt.go instead (different approach)
   199→	bcryptV1 := "package auth\n\nimport \"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt\"\n\nfunc HashPassword(pass string) ([]byte, error) {\n\treturn bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(pass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)\n}"
   200→	authV3 := "package auth\n\nfunc Authenticate(user, pass string) bool {\n\t// Use bcrypt for password hashing\n\treturn false\n}"
   201→	env.WriteFile("src/bcrypt.go", bcryptV1)
   202→	env.WriteFile("src/auth.go", authV3)
   203→
   204→	session.CreateTranscript(
   205→		"Use bcrypt for hashing",
   206→		[]FileChange{
   207→			{Path: "src/bcrypt.go", Content: bcryptV1},
   208→			{Path: "src/auth.go", Content: authV3},
   209→		},
   210→	)
   211→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   212→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 3) failed: %v", err)
   213→	}
   214→
   215→	// Verify we now have checkpoints (may be 3 if history preserved, or could vary)
   216→	points = env.GetRewindPoints()
   217→	if len(points) < 1 {
   218→		t.Fatalf("Expected at least 1 rewind point after checkpoint 3, got %d", len(points))
   219→	}
   220→	t.Logf("After rewind and new checkpoint: %d rewind points", len(points))
   221→
   222→	// ========================================
   223→	// Phase 6: User Commits (Condensation)
   224→	// ========================================
   225→	t.Log("Phase 6: User commits - triggering condensation")
   226→
   227→	// Stage and commit with shadow hooks
   228→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add user authentication with bcrypt", "src/auth.go", "src/bcrypt.go")
   229→
   230→	// Get the new commit
   231→	commit1Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
   232→	t.Logf("User commit 1: %s", commit1Hash[:7])
   233→
   234→	// Active branch commits should be clean (no Entire-* trailers)
   235→	commitMsg := env.GetCommitMessage(commit1Hash)
   236→	if strings.Contains(commitMsg, "Entire-Session:") {
   237→		t.Errorf("Commit should NOT have Entire-Session trailer (clean history), got: %s", commitMsg)
   238→	}
   239→	if strings.Contains(commitMsg, "Entire-Condensation:") {
   240→		t.Errorf("Commit should NOT have Entire-Condensation trailer (clean history), got: %s", commitMsg)
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Get checkpoint ID by walking history - verifies condensation added the trailer
   244→	checkpoint1ID = env.GetLatestCheckpointIDFromHistory()
   245→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 1 ID: %s", checkpoint1ID)
   246→
   247→	// Verify entire/checkpoints/v1 branch exists with checkpoint folder
   248→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   249→		t.Error("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after condensation")
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	// Verify checkpoint folder contents (check via git show)
   253→	// Uses sharded path: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/metadata.json
   254→	checkpointPath := ShardedCheckpointPath(checkpoint1ID) + "/metadata.json"
   255→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, checkpointPath) {
   256→		t.Errorf("Checkpoint folder should contain metadata.json at %s", checkpointPath)
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	// Clear session state to simulate session completion (avoids concurrent session warning)
   260→	if err := env.ClearSessionState(session.ID); err != nil {
   261→		t.Fatalf("ClearSessionState failed: %v", err)
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// ========================================
   265→	// Phase 7: Continue Working After Commit
   266→	// ========================================
   267→	t.Log("Phase 7: Continuing work after user commit")
   268→
   269→	// Verify HEAD changed
   270→	if commit1Hash == initialHead {
   271→		t.Error("HEAD should have changed after user commit")
   272→	}
   273→
   274→	// Start new session
   275→	session4 := env.NewSession()
   276→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session4.ID); err != nil {
   277→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (session4) failed: %v", err)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	// Create session management file
   281→	sessionMgmt := "package auth\n\nimport \"time\"\n\ntype Session struct {\n\tUserID string\n\tExpiry time.Time\n}"
   282→	env.WriteFile("src/session.go", sessionMgmt)
   283→
   284→	session4.CreateTranscript(
   285→		"Add session management",
   286→		[]FileChange{{Path: "src/session.go", Content: sessionMgmt}},
   287→	)
   288→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session4.ID, session4.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   289→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 4) failed: %v", err)
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// Verify NEW shadow branch created (based on new HEAD)
   293→	expectedShadowBranch2 := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(commit1Hash)
   294→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch2) {
   295→		t.Errorf("Expected new shadow branch %s after commit", expectedShadowBranch2)
   296→	}
   297→
   298→	// Verify it's different from the first shadow branch
   299→	if expectedShadowBranch == expectedShadowBranch2 {
   300→		t.Error("New shadow branch should have different name than first (different base commit)")
   301→	}
   302→	t.Logf("New shadow branch after commit: %s", expectedShadowBranch2)
   303→
   304→	// ========================================
   305→	// Phase 8: Second User Commit
   306→	// ========================================
   307→	t.Log("Phase 8: Second user commit")
   308→
   309→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add session management", "src/session.go")
   310→
   311→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
   312→	t.Logf("User commit 2: %s", commit2Hash[:7])
   313→
   314→	// Verify commit is clean (no trailers)
   315→	commitMsg2 := env.GetCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
   316→	if strings.Contains(commitMsg2, "Entire-Session:") {
   317→		t.Errorf("Commit should NOT have Entire-Session trailer (clean history), got: %s", commitMsg2)
   318→	}
   319→
   320→	// Get checkpoint ID from commit message trailer (not from timestamp-based matching
   321→	// which is flaky when commits happen within the same second)
   322→	checkpoint2ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
   323→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2 ID: %s", checkpoint2ID)
   324→
   325→	// Verify DIFFERENT checkpoint ID
   326→	if checkpoint1ID == checkpoint2ID {
   327→		t.Errorf("Second commit should have different checkpoint ID: %s vs %s", checkpoint1ID, checkpoint2ID)
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	// Verify second checkpoint folder exists (uses sharded path)
   331→	checkpoint2Path := ShardedCheckpointPath(checkpoint2ID) + "/metadata.json"
   332→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, checkpoint2Path) {
   333→		t.Errorf("Second checkpoint folder should exist at %s", checkpoint2Path)
   334→	}
   335→
   336→	// ========================================
   337→	// Phase 9: Verify Final State
   338→	// ========================================
   339→	t.Log("Phase 9: Verifying final state")
   340→
   341→	// 2 user commits on feature branch
   342→	// Both should be clean (no Entire-* trailers)
   343→	if strings.Contains(commitMsg, "Entire-Session:") || strings.Contains(commitMsg2, "Entire-Session:") {
   344→		t.Error("Commits should NOT have Entire-Session trailer (clean history)")
   345→	}
   346→
   347→	// 2 checkpoint folders in entire/checkpoints/v1 (Already verified above)
   348→
   349→	// Verify all expected files exist in working directory
   350→	expectedFiles := []string{"README.md", "src/auth.go", "src/bcrypt.go", "src/session.go"}
   351→	for _, f := range expectedFiles {
   352→		if !env.FileExists(f) {
   353→			t.Errorf("Expected file %s to exist in final state", f)
   354→		}
   355→	}
   356→
   357→	// Verify shadow branches exist (can be pruned later)
   358→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch) {
   359→		t.Logf("Note: First shadow branch %s may have been cleaned up", expectedShadowBranch)
   360→	}
   361→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch2) {
   362→		t.Logf("Note: Second shadow branch %s may have been cleaned up", expectedShadowBranch2)
   363→	}
   364→
   365→	t.Log("Shadow full workflow test completed successfully!")
   366→}

   368→// TestShadow_SessionStateLocation verifies session state is stored in .git/
   369→// (not .entire/) so it's never accidentally committed.
   370→func TestShadow_SessionStateLocation(t *testing.T) {
   371→	t.Parallel()
   372→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   373→	defer env.Cleanup()
   374→
   375→	env.InitRepo()
   376→
   377→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test")
   378→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   379→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   380→
   381→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   382→
   383→	// Initialize AFTER branch switch
   384→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   385→
   386→	session := env.NewSession()
   387→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   388→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   389→	}
   390→
   391→	// Session state should be in .git/entire-sessions/, NOT .entire/
   392→	gitSessionDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".git", "entire-sessions")
   393→	entireSessionDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".entire", "entire-sessions")
   394→
   395→	if _, err := os.Stat(gitSessionDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   396→		t.Error("Session state directory should exist at .git/entire-sessions/")
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	if _, err := os.Stat(entireSessionDir); err == nil {
   400→		t.Error("Session state should NOT be in .entire/entire-sessions/")
   401→	}
   402→}

   404→// TestShadow_MultipleConcurrentSessions tests that starting a second Claude session
   405→// while another session has uncommitted checkpoints triggers a warning.
   406→// The first prompt is blocked with continue:false, subsequent prompts proceed.
   407→func TestShadow_MultipleConcurrentSessions(t *testing.T) {
   408→	t.Parallel()
   409→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   410→	defer env.Cleanup()
   411→
   412→	env.InitRepo()
   413→
   414→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test")
   415→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   416→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   417→
   418→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   419→
   420→	// Initialize AFTER branch switch
   421→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   422→
   423→	// Start first session
   424→	session1 := env.NewSession()
   425→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
   426→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (session1) failed: %v", err)
   427→	}
   428→
   429→	// Create a checkpoint for session1 (this creates the shadow branch)
   430→	env.WriteFile("file.txt", "content")
   431→	session1.CreateTranscript("Add file", []FileChange{{Path: "file.txt", Content: "content"}})
   432→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   433→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (session1) failed: %v", err)
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	// Verify session state file exists
   437→	sessionStateDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".git", "entire-sessions")
   438→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(sessionStateDir)
   439→	if err != nil {
   440→		t.Fatalf("Failed to read session state dir: %v", err)
   441→	}
   442→	if len(entries) != 1 {
   443→		t.Errorf("Expected 1 session state file, got %d", len(entries))
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	// Starting a second session while session1 has uncommitted checkpoints triggers warning
   447→	// The hook outputs JSON {"continue":false,...} but returns nil (success)
   448→	session2 := env.NewSession()
   449→	err = env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session2.ID)
   450→	// The hook succeeds (returns nil) but outputs JSON with continue:false
   451→	// The test infrastructure treats this as success since the hook didn't return an error
   452→	if err != nil {
   453→		t.Logf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit returned error (expected in some cases): %v", err)
   454→	}
   455→
   456→	// Verify session2 state file was created with ConcurrentWarningShown flag
   457→	// This is set by the hook when it outputs continue:false
   458→	entries, err = os.ReadDir(sessionStateDir)
   459→	if err != nil {
   460→		t.Fatalf("Failed to read session state dir: %v", err)
   461→	}
   462→	if len(entries) != 2 {
   463→		t.Errorf("Expected 2 session state files after second session attempt, got %d", len(entries))
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	// Clear session1 state file - this makes the shadow branch "orphaned"
   467→	if err := env.ClearSessionState(session1.ID); err != nil {
   468→		t.Fatalf("ClearSessionState failed: %v", err)
   469→	}
   470→
   471→	// Session2 had ConcurrentWarningShown=true, but now the conflict is resolved
   472→	// (session1 state cleared), so the warning flag is cleared and hooks proceed normally.
   473→	// The orphaned shadow branch (from session1) is reset, allowing session2 to proceed.
   474→	err = env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session2.ID)
   475→	if err != nil {
   476→		t.Errorf("Expected success after orphaned shadow branch is reset, got: %v", err)
   477→	} else {
   478→		t.Log("Session2 proceeded after orphaned shadow branch was reset")
   479→	}
   480→}

   482→// TestShadow_ShadowBranchMigrationOnPull verifies that when the base commit changes
   483→// (e.g., after stash → pull → apply), the shadow branch is moved to the new commit.
   484→func TestShadow_ShadowBranchMigrationOnPull(t *testing.T) {
   485→	t.Parallel()
   486→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   487→	defer env.Cleanup()
   488→
   489→	env.InitRepo()
   490→
   491→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test")
   492→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   493→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   494→
   495→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   496→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   497→
   498→	originalHead := env.GetHeadHash()
   499→	originalShadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(originalHead)
   500→
   501→	// Start session and create checkpoint
   502→	session := env.NewSession()
   503→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   504→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	env.WriteFile("file.txt", "content")
   508→	session.CreateTranscript("Add file", []FileChange{{Path: "file.txt", Content: "content"}})
   509→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   510→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   511→	}
   512→
   513→	// Verify shadow branch exists at original commit
   514→	if !env.BranchExists(originalShadowBranch) {
   515→		t.Fatalf("Shadow branch %s should exist", originalShadowBranch)
   516→	}
   517→	t.Logf("Original shadow branch: %s", originalShadowBranch)
   518→
   519→	// Simulate pull: create a new commit (simulating what pull would do)
   520→	// In real scenario: stash → pull → apply
   521→	// Here we just create a commit to simulate HEAD moving
   522→	env.WriteFile("pulled.txt", "from remote")
   523→	env.GitAdd("pulled.txt")
   524→	env.GitCommit("Simulated pull commit")
   525→
   526→	newHead := env.GetHeadHash()
   527→	newShadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(newHead)
   528→	t.Logf("After simulated pull: old=%s new=%s", originalHead[:7], newHead[:7])
   529→
   530→	// Restore the file (simulating stash apply)
   531→	env.WriteFile("file.txt", "content")
   532→
   533→	// Next prompt should migrate the shadow branch
   534→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   535→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit after pull failed: %v", err)
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	// Verify old shadow branch is gone and new one exists
   539→	if env.BranchExists(originalShadowBranch) {
   540→		t.Errorf("Old shadow branch %s should be deleted after migration", originalShadowBranch)
   541→	}
   542→	if !env.BranchExists(newShadowBranch) {
   543→		t.Errorf("New shadow branch %s should exist after migration", newShadowBranch)
   544→	}
   545→
   546→	// Verify we can still create checkpoints on the new shadow branch
   547→	env.WriteFile("file2.txt", "more content")
   548→	session.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   549→	session.CreateTranscript("Add file2", []FileChange{{Path: "file2.txt", Content: "more content"}})
   550→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   551→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop after migration failed: %v", err)
   552→	}
   553→
   554→	// Verify session state has updated base commit and preserves agent type
   555→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
   556→	if err != nil {
   557→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   558→	}
   559→	if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   560→		t.Errorf("Session base commit should be %s, got %s", newHead[:7], state.BaseCommit[:7])
   561→	}
   562→	if state.StepCount != 2 {
   563→		t.Errorf("Expected 2 checkpoints after migration, got %d", state.StepCount)
   564→	}
   565→	// Verify agent_type is preserved across checkpoints and migration
   566→	expectedAgentType := agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode
   567→	if state.AgentType != expectedAgentType {
   568→		t.Errorf("Session AgentType should be %q, got %q", expectedAgentType, state.AgentType)
   569→	}
   570→
   571→	t.Log("Shadow branch successfully migrated after base commit change")
   572→}

   574→// TestShadow_ShadowBranchNaming verifies shadow branches follow the
   575→// entire/<base-sha[:7]> naming convention.
   576→func TestShadow_ShadowBranchNaming(t *testing.T) {
   577→	t.Parallel()
   578→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   579→	defer env.Cleanup()
   580→
   581→	env.InitRepo()
   582→
   583→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test")
   584→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   585→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   586→
   587→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   588→
   589→	// Initialize AFTER branch switch
   590→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   591→
   592→	baseHead := env.GetHeadHash()
   593→
   594→	session := env.NewSession()
   595→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   596→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   597→	}
   598→
   599→	env.WriteFile("file.txt", "content")
   600→	session.CreateTranscript("Add file", []FileChange{{Path: "file.txt", Content: "content"}})
   601→
   602→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   603→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   604→	}
   605→
   606→	// Verify shadow branch name matches worktree-specific format
   607→	expectedBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseHead)
   608→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedBranch) {
   609→		t.Errorf("Shadow branch should be named %s", expectedBranch)
   610→	}
   611→
   612→	// List all entire/ branches
   613→	branches := env.ListBranchesWithPrefix("entire/")
   614→	t.Logf("Found entire/ branches: %v", branches)
   615→
   616→	foundExpected := false
   617→	for _, b := range branches {
   618→		if b == expectedBranch {
   619→			foundExpected = true
   620→			break
   621→		}
   622→	}
   623→	if !foundExpected {
   624→		t.Errorf("Expected branch %s not found in %v", expectedBranch, branches)
   625→	}
   626→}

   628→// TestShadow_TranscriptCondensation verifies that session transcripts are
   629→// included in the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch during condensation.
   630→func TestShadow_TranscriptCondensation(t *testing.T) {
   631→	t.Parallel()
   632→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   633→	defer env.Cleanup()
   634→
   635→	// Setup
   636→	env.InitRepo()
   637→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
   638→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   639→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   640→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   641→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   642→
   643→	// Start session and create checkpoint with transcript
   644→	session := env.NewSession()
   645→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   646→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   647→	}
   648→
   649→	// Create a file change
   650→	content := "package main\n\nfunc main() {\n\tprintln(\"hello\")\n}\n"
   651→	env.WriteFile("main.go", content)
   652→
   653→	// Create transcript with meaningful content
   654→	session.CreateTranscript(
   655→		"Create main.go with hello world",
   656→		[]FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: content}},
   657→	)
   658→
   659→	// Save checkpoint (this stores transcript in shadow branch)
   660→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   661→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   662→	}
   663→
   664→	// Commit with hooks (triggers condensation)
   665→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add main.go", "main.go")
   666→
   667→	// Get checkpoint ID from entire/checkpoints/v1 branch (not from commit message)
   668→	checkpointID := env.GetLatestCheckpointID()
   669→	t.Logf("Checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID)
   670→
   671→	// Verify entire/checkpoints/v1 branch exists
   672→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   673→		t.Fatal("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after condensation")
   674→	}
   675→
   676→	// Verify root metadata.json (CheckpointSummary) exists
   677→	summaryPath := CheckpointSummaryPath(checkpointID)
   678→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, summaryPath) {
   679→		t.Errorf("root metadata.json should exist at %s", summaryPath)
   680→	}
   681→
   682→	// Verify transcript file exists in session subdirectory (new format: 0/full.jsonl)
   683→	transcriptPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   684→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, transcriptPath) {
   685→		t.Errorf("Transcript (%s) should exist at %s", paths.TranscriptFileName, transcriptPath)
   686→	} else {
   687→		t.Log("✓ Transcript file exists in checkpoint")
   688→	}
   689→
   690→	// Verify content_hash.txt exists in session subdirectory
   691→	hashPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, "content_hash.txt")
   692→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, hashPath) {
   693→		t.Errorf("content_hash.txt should exist at %s", hashPath)
   694→	}
   695→
   696→	// Verify root metadata.json can be read and parsed as CheckpointSummary
   697→	summaryContent, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, summaryPath)
   698→	if !found {
   699→		t.Fatal("root metadata.json should be readable")
   700→	}
   701→	var summary checkpoint.CheckpointSummary
   702→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(summaryContent), &summary); err != nil {
   703→		t.Fatalf("failed to parse root metadata.json as CheckpointSummary: %v", err)
   704→	}
   705→
   706→	// Verify Sessions array is populated
   707→	if len(summary.Sessions) == 0 {
   708→		t.Errorf("CheckpointSummary.Sessions should have at least one entry")
   709→	} else {
   710→		t.Logf("✓ CheckpointSummary has %d session(s)", len(summary.Sessions))
   711→	}
   712→
   713→	// Verify agent field is in session-level metadata (not root summary)
   714→	sessionMetadataPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, paths.MetadataFileName)
   715→	sessionMetadataContent, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, sessionMetadataPath)
   716→	if !found {
   717→		t.Fatal("session metadata.json should be readable")
   718→	}
   719→	var sessionMetadata checkpoint.CommittedMetadata
   720→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(sessionMetadataContent), &sessionMetadata); err != nil {
   721→		t.Fatalf("failed to parse session metadata.json: %v", err)
   722→	}
   723→	expectedAgent := agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode
   724→	if sessionMetadata.Agent != expectedAgent {
   725→		t.Errorf("session metadata.Agent = %q, want %q", sessionMetadata.Agent, expectedAgent)
   726→	} else {
   727→		t.Logf("✓ Session metadata has agent: %q", sessionMetadata.Agent)
   728→	}
   729→}

   731→// TestShadow_FullTranscriptContext verifies that each checkpoint includes
   732→// the full session transcript, preserving complete history across commits.
   733→//
   734→// This tests transcript preservation:
   735→// - First commit: context.md includes prompts 1-2
   736→// - Second commit: context.md includes prompts 1-3 (full transcript preserved)
   737→func TestShadow_FullTranscriptContext(t *testing.T) {
   738→	t.Parallel()
   739→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   740→	defer env.Cleanup()
   741→
   742→	// Setup repository
   743→	env.InitRepo()
   744→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
   745→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   746→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   747→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/incremental")
   748→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   749→
   750→	t.Log("Phase 1: First session with two prompts")
   751→
   752→	// Start first session
   753→	session1 := env.NewSession()
   754→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
   755→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   756→	}
   757→
   758→	// First prompt: create file A
   759→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
   760→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
   761→
   762→	// Build transcript with first prompt
   763→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A in a.go")
   764→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function A for you.")
   765→	toolID1 := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
   766→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID1)
   767→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function A!")
   768→
   769→	// Second prompt in same session: create file B
   770→	fileBContent := "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n"
   771→	env.WriteFile("b.go", fileBContent)
   772→
   773→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Now create function B in b.go")
   774→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function B for you.")
   775→	toolID2 := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", fileBContent)
   776→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
   777→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function B!")
   778→
   779→	// Write transcript
   780→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   781→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   782→	}
   783→
   784→	// Save checkpoint (triggers SaveChanges)
   785→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   786→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   787→	}
   788→
   789→	t.Log("Phase 2: First user commit")
   790→
   791→	// User commits
   792→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add functions A and B", "a.go", "b.go")
   793→
   794→	// Get first checkpoint ID from commit message trailer
   795→	commit1Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
   796→	checkpoint1ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit1Hash)
   797→	t.Logf("First checkpoint ID: %s", checkpoint1ID)
   798→
   799→	// Verify first checkpoint has both prompts (uses session file path in numbered subdirectory)
   800→	promptPath1 := SessionFilePath(checkpoint1ID, "prompt.txt")
   801→	prompt1Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, promptPath1)
   802→	if !found {
   803→		t.Errorf("prompt.txt should exist at %s", promptPath1)
   804→	} else {
   805→		t.Logf("First prompt.txt content:\n%s", prompt1Content)
   806→		// Should contain both "Create function A" and "create function B"
   807→		if !strings.Contains(prompt1Content, "Create function A") {
   808→			t.Error("First prompt.txt should contain 'Create function A'")
   809→		}
   810→		if !strings.Contains(prompt1Content, "create function B") {
   811→			t.Error("First prompt.txt should contain 'create function B'")
   812→		}
   813→	}
   814→
   815→	contextPath1 := SessionFilePath(checkpoint1ID, "context.md")
   816→	context1Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, contextPath1)
   817→	if !found {
   818→		t.Errorf("context.md should exist at %s", contextPath1)
   819→	} else {
   820→		t.Logf("First context.md content:\n%s", context1Content)
   821→	}
   822→
   823→	t.Log("Phase 3: Continue session with third prompt")
   824→
   825→	// Continue the session with a new prompt
   826→	// First, simulate another user prompt submit to track the new base
   827→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
   828→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (continued) failed: %v", err)
   829→	}
   830→
   831→	// Third prompt: create file C
   832→	fileCContent := "package main\n\nfunc C() {}\n"
   833→	env.WriteFile("c.go", fileCContent)
   834→
   835→	// Add to transcript (continuing from previous)
   836→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Finally, create function C in c.go")
   837→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function C for you.")
   838→	toolID3 := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "c.go", fileCContent)
   839→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID3)
   840→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function C!")
   841→
   842→	// Write updated transcript
   843→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   844→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write updated transcript: %v", err)
   845→	}
   846→
   847→	// Save checkpoint
   848→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   849→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (second) failed: %v", err)
   850→	}
   851→
   852→	t.Log("Phase 4: Second user commit")
   853→
   854→	// User commits again
   855→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function C", "c.go")
   856→
   857→	// Get second checkpoint ID from commit message trailer
   858→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
   859→	checkpoint2ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
   860→	t.Logf("Second checkpoint ID: %s", checkpoint2ID)
   861→
   862→	// Verify different checkpoint IDs
   863→	if checkpoint1ID == checkpoint2ID {
   864→		t.Errorf("Second commit should have different checkpoint ID: %s vs %s", checkpoint1ID, checkpoint2ID)
   865→	}
   866→
   867→	t.Log("Phase 5: Verify full transcript preserved in second checkpoint")
   868→
   869→	// Verify second checkpoint has the FULL transcript (all three prompts)
   870→	// Session files are now in numbered subdirectories (e.g., 0/prompt.txt)
   871→	promptPath2 := SessionFilePath(checkpoint2ID, "prompt.txt")
   872→	prompt2Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, promptPath2)
   873→	if !found {
   874→		t.Errorf("prompt.txt should exist at %s", promptPath2)
   875→	} else {
   876→		t.Logf("Second prompt.txt content:\n%s", prompt2Content)
   877→
   878→		// Should contain all prompts (full transcript preserved)
   879→		if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "create function C") {
   880→			t.Error("Second prompt.txt should contain 'create function C'")
   881→		}
   882→		if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "Create function A") {
   883→			t.Error("Second prompt.txt should contain 'Create function A' (full transcript)")
   884→		}
   885→		if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "create function B") {
   886→			t.Error("Second prompt.txt should contain 'create function B' (full transcript)")
   887→		}
   888→	}
   889→
   890→	contextPath2 := SessionFilePath(checkpoint2ID, "context.md")
   891→	context2Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, contextPath2)
   892→	if !found {
   893→		t.Errorf("context.md should exist at %s", contextPath2)
   894→	} else {
   895→		t.Logf("Second context.md content:\n%s", context2Content)
   896→
   897→		// Should contain full transcript context
   898→		if !strings.Contains(context2Content, "Create function A") {
   899→			t.Error("Second context.md should contain 'Create function A' (full transcript)")
   900→		}
   901→	}
   902→
   903→	t.Log("Shadow full transcript context test completed successfully!")
   904→}
   905→
   906→// TestShadow_RewindAndCondensation verifies that after rewinding to an earlier
   907→// checkpoint, the checkpoint only includes prompts up to that point.
   908→//
   909→// Workflow:
   910→// 1. Create checkpoint 1 (prompt 1)
   911→// 2. Create checkpoint 2 (prompt 2)
   912→// 3. Rewind to checkpoint 1
   913→// 4. User commits
   914→// 5. Verify checkpoint only contains prompt 1 (NOT prompt 2)
   915→func TestShadow_RewindAndCondensation(t *testing.T) {
   916→	t.Parallel()
   917→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   918→	defer env.Cleanup()
   919→
   920→	// Setup repository
   921→	env.InitRepo()
   922→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
   923→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   924→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   925→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/rewind-test")
   926→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   927→
   928→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create first checkpoint with prompt 1")
   929→
   930→	session := env.NewSession()
   931→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   932→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   933→	}
   934→
   935→	// First prompt: create file A
   936→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
   937→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
   938→
   939→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A in a.go")
   940→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function A for you.")
   941→	toolID1 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
   942→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID1)
   943→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function A!")
   944→
   945→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   946→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   947→	}
   948→
   949→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   950→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
   951→	}
   952→
   953→	// Get checkpoint 1 for later
   954→	rewindPoints := env.GetRewindPoints()
   955→	if len(rewindPoints) != 1 {
   956→		t.Fatalf("Expected 1 rewind point after checkpoint 1, got %d", len(rewindPoints))
   957→	}
   958→	checkpoint1 := rewindPoints[0]
   959→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 1: %s - %s", checkpoint1.ID[:7], checkpoint1.Message)
   960→
   961→	t.Log("Phase 2: Create second checkpoint with prompt 2")
   962→
   963→	// Second prompt: modify file A (a different approach)
   964→	fileAModified := "package main\n\nfunc A() {\n\t// Modified version\n}\n"
   965→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAModified)
   966→
   967→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Actually, modify function A to have a comment")
   968→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll modify function A for you.")
   969→	toolID2 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAModified)
   970→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
   971→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done modifying function A!")
   972→
   973→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   974→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   975→	}
   976→
   977→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   978→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
   979→	}
   980→
   981→	rewindPoints = env.GetRewindPoints()
   982→	if len(rewindPoints) != 2 {
   983→		t.Fatalf("Expected 2 rewind points after checkpoint 2, got %d", len(rewindPoints))
   984→	}
   985→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2: %s - %s", rewindPoints[0].ID[:7], rewindPoints[0].Message)
   986→
   987→	// Verify file has modified content
   988→	currentContent := env.ReadFile("a.go")
   989→	if currentContent != fileAModified {
   990→		t.Errorf("a.go should have modified content before rewind")
   991→	}
   992→
   993→	t.Log("Phase 3: Rewind to checkpoint 1")
   994→
   995→	// Rewind using the CLI (which calls the strategy internally)
   996→	if err := env.Rewind(checkpoint1.ID); err != nil {
   997→		t.Fatalf("Rewind failed: %v", err)
   998→	}
   999→
  1000→	// Verify file content is restored to checkpoint 1
  1001→	restoredContent := env.ReadFile("a.go")
  1002→	if restoredContent != fileAContent {
  1003→		t.Errorf("a.go should have original content after rewind.\nExpected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", fileAContent, restoredContent)
  1004→	}
  1005→	t.Log("Files successfully restored to checkpoint 1")
  1006→
  1007→	t.Log("Phase 4: User commits after rewind")
  1008→
  1009→	// User commits - this should trigger condensation
  1010→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function A (reverted)", "a.go")
  1011→
  1012→	// Get checkpoint ID from commit message trailer
  1013→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1014→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commitHash)
  1015→	t.Logf("Checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID)
  1016→
  1017→	t.Log("Phase 5: Verify checkpoint only contains prompt 1")
  1018→
  1019→	// Check prompt.txt (uses session file path in numbered subdirectory)
  1020→	promptPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, "prompt.txt")
  1021→	promptContent, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, promptPath)
  1022→	if !found {
  1023→		t.Errorf("prompt.txt should exist at %s", promptPath)
  1024→	} else {
  1025→		t.Logf("prompt.txt content:\n%s", promptContent)
  1026→
  1027→		// Should contain prompt 1
  1028→		if !strings.Contains(promptContent, "Create function A") {
  1029→			t.Error("prompt.txt should contain 'Create function A' from checkpoint 1")
  1030→		}
  1031→
  1032→		// Should NOT contain prompt 2 (because we rewound past it)
  1033→		if strings.Contains(promptContent, "modify function A") {
  1034→			t.Error("prompt.txt should NOT contain 'modify function A' - we rewound past that checkpoint")
  1035→		}
  1036→	}
  1037→
  1038→	// Check context.md
  1039→	contextPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, "context.md")
  1040→	contextContent, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, contextPath)
  1041→	if !found {
  1042→		t.Errorf("context.md should exist at %s", contextPath)
  1043→	} else {
  1044→		t.Logf("context.md content:\n%s", contextContent)
  1045→
  1046→		// Should NOT contain context from checkpoint 2
  1047→		if strings.Contains(contextContent, "modify function A") {
  1048→			t.Error("context.md should NOT contain 'modify function A' - we rewound past that checkpoint")
  1049→		}
  1050→	}
  1051→
  1052→	t.Log("Shadow rewind and condensation test completed successfully!")
  1053→}
  1054→
  1055→// TestShadow_RewindPreservesUntrackedFilesFromSessionStart tests that files that existed
  1056→// in the working directory (but weren't tracked in git) before the session started are
  1057→// preserved when rewinding. This was a bug where such files were incorrectly deleted.
  1058→func TestShadow_RewindPreservesUntrackedFilesFromSessionStart(t *testing.T) {
  1059→	t.Parallel()
  1060→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1061→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1062→
  1063→	// Setup repository with initial commit
  1064→	env.InitRepo()
  1065→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
  1066→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
  1067→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
  1068→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/untracked-test")
  1069→
  1070→	// Create an untracked file BEFORE initializing Entire session
  1071→	// This simulates files like .claude/settings.json created by "entire setup"
  1072→	untrackedContent := `{"key": "value"}`
  1073→	env.WriteFile(".claude/settings.json", untrackedContent)
  1074→
  1075→	// Initialize Entire with manual-commit strategy
  1076→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
  1077→
  1078→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create first checkpoint")
  1079→
  1080→	session := env.NewSession()
  1081→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1082→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1083→	}
  1084→
  1085→	// First prompt: create file A
  1086→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
  1087→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
  1088→
  1089→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A")
  1090→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1091→	toolID1 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
  1092→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID1)
  1093→
  1094→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1095→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1096→	}
  1097→
  1098→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1099→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
  1100→	}
  1101→
  1102→	rewindPoints := env.GetRewindPoints()
  1103→	if len(rewindPoints) != 1 {
  1104→		t.Fatalf("Expected 1 rewind point, got %d", len(rewindPoints))
  1105→	}
  1106→	checkpoint1 := rewindPoints[0]
  1107→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 1: %s", checkpoint1.ID[:7])
  1108→
  1109→	t.Log("Phase 2: Create second checkpoint")
  1110→
  1111→	// Second prompt: create file B
  1112→	fileBContent := "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n"
  1113→	env.WriteFile("b.go", fileBContent)
  1114→
  1115→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function B")
  1116→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1117→	toolID2 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", fileBContent)
  1118→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
  1119→
  1120→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1121→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1122→	}
  1123→
  1124→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1125→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
  1126→	}
  1127→
  1128→	rewindPoints = env.GetRewindPoints()
  1129→	if len(rewindPoints) != 2 {
  1130→		t.Fatalf("Expected 2 rewind points, got %d", len(rewindPoints))
  1131→	}
  1132→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2: %s", rewindPoints[0].ID[:7])
  1133→
  1134→	// Verify the untracked file still exists before rewind
  1135→	if !env.FileExists(".claude/settings.json") {
  1136→		t.Fatal("Untracked file .claude/settings.json should exist before rewind")
  1137→	}
  1138→
  1139→	t.Log("Phase 3: Rewind to checkpoint 1")
  1140→
  1141→	if err := env.Rewind(checkpoint1.ID); err != nil {
  1142→		t.Fatalf("Rewind failed: %v", err)
  1143→	}
  1144→
  1145→	// Verify that the untracked file that existed before session start is PRESERVED
  1146→	if !env.FileExists(".claude/settings.json") {
  1147→		t.Error("CRITICAL: .claude/settings.json was deleted during rewind but it existed before the session started!")
  1148→	} else {
  1149→		restoredContent := env.ReadFile(".claude/settings.json")
  1150→		if restoredContent != untrackedContent {
  1151→			t.Errorf("Untracked file content changed.\nExpected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", untrackedContent, restoredContent)
  1152→		} else {
  1153→			t.Log("✓ Untracked file .claude/settings.json was preserved correctly")
  1154→		}
  1155→	}
  1156→
  1157→	// Verify b.go was deleted (it was created after checkpoint 1)
  1158→	if env.FileExists("b.go") {
  1159→		t.Error("b.go should have been deleted during rewind (it was created after checkpoint 1)")
  1160→	} else {
  1161→		t.Log("✓ b.go was correctly deleted during rewind")
  1162→	}
  1163→
  1164→	// Verify a.go was restored
  1165→	if !env.FileExists("a.go") {
  1166→		t.Error("a.go should exist after rewind to checkpoint 1")
  1167→	} else {
  1168→		restoredA := env.ReadFile("a.go")
  1169→		if restoredA != fileAContent {
  1170→			t.Errorf("a.go content incorrect after rewind")
  1171→		} else {
  1172→			t.Log("✓ a.go was correctly restored")
  1173→		}
  1174→	}
  1175→
  1176→	t.Log("Test completed successfully!")
  1177→}
  1178→
  1179→// TestShadow_IntermediateCommitsWithoutPrompts tests that commits without new Claude
  1180→// content do NOT get checkpoint trailers.
  1181→//
  1182→// Scenario:
  1183→// 1. Session starts, work happens, checkpoint created
  1184→// 2. First commit gets a trailer (has new content)
  1185→// 3. User commits unrelated files without new Claude work - NO trailer (no new content)
  1186→// 4. User enters new prompt, creates more files
  1187→// 5. Second commit with Claude content gets a trailer
  1188→func TestShadow_IntermediateCommitsWithoutPrompts(t *testing.T) {
  1189→	t.Parallel()
  1190→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1191→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1192→
  1193→	// Setup repository
  1194→	env.InitRepo()
  1195→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
  1196→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
  1197→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
  1198→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/intermediate-commits")
  1199→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
  1200→
  1201→	t.Log("Phase 1: Start session and create checkpoint")
  1202→
  1203→	session := env.NewSession()
  1204→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1205→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1206→	}
  1207→
  1208→	// First prompt: create file A
  1209→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
  1210→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
  1211→
  1212→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A in a.go")
  1213→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function A for you.")
  1214→	toolID1 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
  1215→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID1)
  1216→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function A!")
  1217→
  1218→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1219→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1220→	}
  1221→
  1222→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1223→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1224→	}
  1225→
  1226→	t.Log("Phase 2: First commit (with session content)")
  1227→
  1228→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function A", "a.go")
  1229→	commit1Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1230→	checkpoint1ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit1Hash)
  1231→	t.Logf("First commit: %s, checkpoint from trailer: %s", commit1Hash[:7], checkpoint1ID)
  1232→	t.Logf("First commit message:\n%s", env.GetCommitMessage(commit1Hash))
  1233→
  1234→	if checkpoint1ID == "" {
  1235→		t.Fatal("First commit should have a checkpoint ID in its trailer (has new content)")
  1236→	}
  1237→
  1238→	t.Log("Phase 3: Create unrelated file and commit WITHOUT new prompt")
  1239→
  1240→	// User creates an unrelated file and commits without entering a new Claude prompt
  1241→	// Since there's no new session content, this commit should NOT get a trailer
  1242→	env.WriteFile("unrelated.txt", "This is an unrelated file")
  1243→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add unrelated file", "unrelated.txt")
  1244→
  1245→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1246→	checkpoint2ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
  1247→	t.Logf("Second commit: %s, checkpoint from trailer: %s", commit2Hash[:7], checkpoint2ID)
  1248→	t.Logf("Second commit message:\n%s", env.GetCommitMessage(commit2Hash))
  1249→
  1250→	// Second commit should NOT get a checkpoint ID (no new session content)
  1251→	if checkpoint2ID != "" {
  1252→		t.Errorf("Second commit should NOT have a checkpoint trailer (no new content), got: %s", checkpoint2ID)
  1253→	}
  1254→
  1255→	t.Log("Phase 4: New Claude work and commit")
  1256→
  1257→	// Now user enters new prompt and does more work
  1258→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1259→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1260→	}
  1261→
  1262→	fileBContent := "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n"
  1263→	env.WriteFile("b.go", fileBContent)
  1264→
  1265→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function B in b.go")
  1266→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function B for you.")
  1267→	toolID2 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", fileBContent)
  1268→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
  1269→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done creating function B!")
  1270→
  1271→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1272→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1273→	}
  1274→
  1275→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1276→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1277→	}
  1278→
  1279→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function B", "b.go")
  1280→
  1281→	commit3Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1282→	checkpoint3ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit3Hash)
  1283→	t.Logf("Third commit: %s, checkpoint from trailer: %s", commit3Hash[:7], checkpoint3ID)
  1284→	t.Logf("Third commit message:\n%s", env.GetCommitMessage(commit3Hash))
  1285→
  1286→	if checkpoint3ID == "" {
  1287→		t.Fatal("Third commit should have a checkpoint ID (has new content)")
  1288→	}
  1289→
  1290→	// First and third checkpoint IDs should be different
  1291→	if checkpoint1ID == checkpoint3ID {
  1292→		t.Errorf("First and third commits should have different checkpoint IDs: %s vs %s",
  1293→			checkpoint1ID, checkpoint3ID)
  1294→	}
  1295→
  1296→	t.Log("Phase 5: Verify checkpoints exist in entire/checkpoints/v1")
  1297→
  1298→	for _, cpID := range []string{checkpoint1ID, checkpoint3ID} {
  1299→		shardedPath := ShardedCheckpointPath(cpID)
  1300→		metadataPath := shardedPath + "/metadata.json"
  1301→		if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, metadataPath) {
  1302→			t.Errorf("Checkpoint %s should have metadata.json at %s", cpID, metadataPath)
  1303→		}
  1304→	}
  1305→
  1306→	t.Log("Intermediate commits test completed successfully!")
  1307→}

  1309→// TestShadow_FullTranscriptCondensationWithIntermediateCommits tests that full transcripts
  1310→// are preserved across multiple commits.
  1311→//
  1312→// Scenario:
  1313→// 1. Session with prompts A and B, commit 1
  1314→// 2. Continue session with prompt C, commit 2 (without intermediate prompt submit)
  1315→// 3. Verify commit 2's checkpoint has full transcript (A, B, and C)
  1316→func TestShadow_FullTranscriptCondensationWithIntermediateCommits(t *testing.T) {
  1317→	t.Parallel()
  1318→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1319→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1320→
  1321→	// Setup repository
  1322→	env.InitRepo()
  1323→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
  1324→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
  1325→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
  1326→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/incremental-intermediate")
  1327→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
  1328→
  1329→	t.Log("Phase 1: Session with two prompts")
  1330→
  1331→	session := env.NewSession()
  1332→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1333→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1334→	}
  1335→
  1336→	// First prompt
  1337→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
  1338→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
  1339→
  1340→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A")
  1341→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1342→	toolID1 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
  1343→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID1)
  1344→
  1345→	// Second prompt in same session
  1346→	fileBContent := "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n"
  1347→	env.WriteFile("b.go", fileBContent)
  1348→
  1349→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function B")
  1350→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1351→	toolID2 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", fileBContent)
  1352→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
  1353→
  1354→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1355→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1356→	}
  1357→
  1358→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1359→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1360→	}
  1361→
  1362→	t.Log("Phase 2: First commit")
  1363→
  1364→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add functions A and B", "a.go", "b.go")
  1365→	commit1Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1366→	checkpoint1ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit1Hash)
  1367→	t.Logf("First commit: %s, checkpoint: %s", commit1Hash[:7], checkpoint1ID)
  1368→
  1369→	// Verify first checkpoint has prompts A and B (session files in numbered subdirectory)
  1370→	prompt1Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, SessionFilePath(checkpoint1ID, "prompt.txt"))
  1371→	if !found {
  1372→		t.Fatal("First checkpoint should have prompt.txt")
  1373→	}
  1374→	if !strings.Contains(prompt1Content, "function A") || !strings.Contains(prompt1Content, "function B") {
  1375→		t.Errorf("First checkpoint should contain prompts A and B, got: %s", prompt1Content)
  1376→	}
  1377→	t.Logf("First checkpoint prompts:\n%s", prompt1Content)
  1378→
  1379→	t.Log("Phase 3: Continue session with third prompt (no SimulateUserPromptSubmit)")
  1380→
  1381→	// Continue working WITHOUT calling SimulateUserPromptSubmit
  1382→	// This simulates the case where HEAD moved but InitializeSession wasn't called
  1383→	fileCContent := "package main\n\nfunc C() {}\n"
  1384→	env.WriteFile("c.go", fileCContent)
  1385→
  1386→	// Add to transcript
  1387→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function C")
  1388→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1389→	toolID3 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "c.go", fileCContent)
  1390→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID3)
  1391→
  1392→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1393→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write updated transcript: %v", err)
  1394→	}
  1395→
  1396→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1397→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (second) failed: %v", err)
  1398→	}
  1399→
  1400→	t.Log("Phase 4: Second commit (without intermediate prompt submit)")
  1401→
  1402→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function C", "c.go")
  1403→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1404→	checkpoint2ID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
  1405→	t.Logf("Second commit: %s, checkpoint: %s", commit2Hash[:7], checkpoint2ID)
  1406→
  1407→	if checkpoint1ID == checkpoint2ID {
  1408→		t.Errorf("Commits should have different checkpoint IDs")
  1409→	}
  1410→
  1411→	t.Log("Phase 5: Verify second checkpoint has full transcript (A, B, and C)")
  1412→
  1413→	// Session files are now in numbered subdirectory (e.g., 0/prompt.txt)
  1414→	prompt2Content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, SessionFilePath(checkpoint2ID, "prompt.txt"))
  1415→	if !found {
  1416→		t.Fatal("Second checkpoint should have prompt.txt")
  1417→	}
  1418→
  1419→	t.Logf("Second checkpoint prompts:\n%s", prompt2Content)
  1420→
  1421→	// Should contain all prompts (full transcript preserved)
  1422→	if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "function C") {
  1423→		t.Error("Second checkpoint should contain 'function C'")
  1424→	}
  1425→	if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "function A") {
  1426→		t.Error("Second checkpoint should contain 'function A' (full transcript)")
  1427→	}
  1428→	if !strings.Contains(prompt2Content, "function B") {
  1429→		t.Error("Second checkpoint should contain 'function B' (full transcript)")
  1430→	}
  1431→
  1432→	t.Log("Full transcript condensation with intermediate commits test completed successfully!")
  1433→}
  1434→
  1435→// TestShadow_RewindPreservesUntrackedFilesWithExistingShadowBranch tests that untracked files
  1436→// present at session start are preserved during rewind, even when the shadow branch already
  1437→// exists from a previous session.
  1438→func TestShadow_RewindPreservesUntrackedFilesWithExistingShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {
  1439→	t.Parallel()
  1440→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1441→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1442→
  1443→	// Setup repository with initial commit
  1444→	env.InitRepo()
  1445→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
  1446→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
  1447→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
  1448→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/existing-shadow-test")
  1449→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
  1450→
  1451→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create untracked file before session starts")
  1452→
  1453→	// Create an untracked file BEFORE the first checkpoint
  1454→	// This simulates configuration files that exist before Claude starts
  1455→	untrackedContent := `{"new": "config"}`
  1456→	env.WriteFile(".claude/settings.json", untrackedContent)
  1457→
  1458→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create a previous session to establish shadow branch")
  1459→
  1460→	// First session - creates the shadow branch
  1461→	session1 := env.NewSession()
  1462→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
  1463→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1464→	}
  1465→
  1466→	env.WriteFile("old.go", "package main\n")
  1467→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create old.go")
  1468→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1469→	toolID := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "old.go", "package main\n")
  1470→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID)
  1471→
  1472→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1473→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1474→	}
  1475→
  1476→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1477→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (session 1) failed: %v", err)
  1478→	}
  1479→
  1480→	// Verify shadow branch exists
  1481→	shadowBranchName := env.GetShadowBranchName()
  1482→	if !env.BranchExists(shadowBranchName) {
  1483→		t.Fatalf("Shadow branch %s should exist after first session", shadowBranchName)
  1484→	}
  1485→	t.Logf("Shadow branch %s exists from first session", shadowBranchName)
  1486→
  1487→	t.Log("Phase 2: Continue session and create second checkpoint")
  1488→
  1489→	// Continue the SAME session (Claude resumes with the same session ID)
  1490→	// This is the expected behavior - continuing work on the same base commit
  1491→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
  1492→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (continue session) failed: %v", err)
  1493→	}
  1494→
  1495→	// Reset transcript builder for next checkpoint
  1496→	session1.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
  1497→
  1498→	// Second checkpoint of session - should capture .claude/settings.json
  1499→	env.WriteFile("a.go", "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n")
  1500→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create A")
  1501→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1502→	toolID2 := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n")
  1503→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
  1504→
  1505→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1506→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1507→	}
  1508→
  1509→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1510→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
  1511→	}
  1512→
  1513→	rewindPoints := env.GetRewindPoints()
  1514→	if len(rewindPoints) < 2 {
  1515→		t.Fatalf("Expected at least 2 rewind points, got %d", len(rewindPoints))
  1516→	}
  1517→	// Find the most recent checkpoint (checkpoint 2)
  1518→	checkpoint1 := &rewindPoints[0] // Most recent first
  1519→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2: %s", checkpoint1.ID[:7])
  1520→
  1521→	t.Log("Phase 3: Create third checkpoint")
  1522→
  1523→	// Continue the session for the third checkpoint
  1524→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
  1525→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (checkpoint 3) failed: %v", err)
  1526→	}
  1527→
  1528→	// Reset transcript builder for next checkpoint
  1529→	session1.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
  1530→
  1531→	env.WriteFile("b.go", "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n")
  1532→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create B")
  1533→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1534→	toolID3 := session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n")
  1535→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID3)
  1536→
  1537→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1538→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1539→	}
  1540→
  1541→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1542→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 3) failed: %v", err)
  1543→	}
  1544→
  1545→	t.Log("Phase 4: Rewind to checkpoint 2")
  1546→
  1547→	if err := env.Rewind(checkpoint1.ID); err != nil {
  1548→		t.Fatalf("Rewind failed: %v", err)
  1549→	}
  1550→
  1551→	// Verify that the untracked file that existed at session start is PRESERVED
  1552→	// Since .claude/settings.json was created before checkpoint 1, it's in checkpoint 1's tree
  1553→	// and will flow through to checkpoint 2, so it should be preserved on rewind
  1554→	if !env.FileExists(".claude/settings.json") {
  1555→		t.Error(".claude/settings.json should have been preserved during rewind")
  1556→	} else {
  1557→		restoredContent := env.ReadFile(".claude/settings.json")
  1558→		if restoredContent != untrackedContent {
  1559→			t.Errorf("Untracked file content changed.\nExpected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", untrackedContent, restoredContent)
  1560→		} else {
  1561→			t.Log("✓ .claude/settings.json was preserved correctly")
  1562→		}
  1563→	}
  1564→
  1565→	// Verify b.go was deleted
  1566→	if env.FileExists("b.go") {
  1567→		t.Error("b.go should have been deleted during rewind")
  1568→	} else {
  1569→		t.Log("✓ b.go was correctly deleted during rewind")
  1570→	}
  1571→
  1572→	t.Log("Test completed successfully!")
  1573→}

  1575→// TestShadow_TrailerRemovalSkipsCondensation tests that removing the Entire-Checkpoint
  1576→// trailer during commit message editing causes condensation to be skipped.
  1577→// This allows users to opt-out of linking a commit to their Claude session.
  1578→func TestShadow_TrailerRemovalSkipsCondensation(t *testing.T) {
  1579→	t.Parallel()
  1580→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1581→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1582→
  1583→	// Setup
  1584→	env.InitRepo()
  1585→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
  1586→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
  1587→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
  1588→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/trailer-opt-out")
  1589→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
  1590→
  1591→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create session with content")
  1592→
  1593→	session := env.NewSession()
  1594→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1595→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1596→	}
  1597→
  1598→	fileAContent := "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n"
  1599→	env.WriteFile("a.go", fileAContent)
  1600→
  1601→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function A")
  1602→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create function A for you.")
  1603→	toolID := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "a.go", fileAContent)
  1604→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID)
  1605→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1606→
  1607→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1608→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1609→	}
  1610→
  1611→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1612→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1613→	}
  1614→
  1615→	t.Log("Phase 2: Commit WITH trailer removed (user opts out)")
  1616→
  1617→	// Use the special helper that removes the trailer before committing
  1618→	env.GitCommitWithTrailerRemoved("Add function A (manual commit)", "a.go")
  1619→
  1620→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1621→	t.Logf("Commit: %s", commitHash[:7])
  1622→
  1623→	// Verify commit does NOT have trailer
  1624→	commitMsg := env.GetCommitMessage(commitHash)
  1625→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commitMsg); found {
  1626→		t.Errorf("Commit should NOT have Entire-Checkpoint trailer (it was removed), got:\n%s", commitMsg)
  1627→	}
  1628→	t.Logf("Commit message (trailer removed):\n%s", commitMsg)
  1629→
  1630→	t.Log("Phase 3: Verify no condensation happened")
  1631→
  1632→	// entire/checkpoints/v1 branch exists (created at setup), but should not have any checkpoint commits yet
  1633→	// since the user removed the trailer
  1634→	latestCheckpointID := env.TryGetLatestCheckpointID()
  1635→	if latestCheckpointID == "" {
  1636→		t.Log("✓ No checkpoint found on entire/checkpoints/v1 branch (no condensation)")
  1637→	} else {
  1638→		// If there is a checkpoint, this is unexpected for this test
  1639→		t.Logf("Found checkpoint ID: %s (should be from previous activity, not this commit)", latestCheckpointID)
  1640→	}
  1641→
  1642→	t.Log("Phase 4: Now commit WITH trailer (user keeps it)")
  1643→
  1644→	// Continue session with new content
  1645→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
  1646→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
  1647→	}
  1648→
  1649→	fileBContent := "package main\n\nfunc B() {}\n"
  1650→	env.WriteFile("b.go", fileBContent)
  1651→
  1652→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create function B")
  1653→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
  1654→	toolID2 := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "b.go", fileBContent)
  1655→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID2)
  1656→
  1657→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1658→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
  1659→	}
  1660→
  1661→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1662→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1663→	}
  1664→
  1665→	// This time, keep the trailer (normal commit with hooks)
  1666→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add function B", "b.go")
  1667→
  1668→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()
  1669→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
  1670→	t.Logf("Second commit: %s, checkpoint: %s", commit2Hash[:7], checkpointID)
  1671→
  1672→	// Verify second commit HAS trailer with valid format
  1673→	commit2Msg := env.GetCommitMessage(commit2Hash)
  1674→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit2Msg); !found {
  1675→		t.Errorf("Second commit should have valid Entire-Checkpoint trailer, got:\n%s", commit2Msg)
  1676→	}
  1677→
  1678→	// Verify condensation happened for second commit
  1679→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
  1680→		t.Fatal("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after second commit with trailer")
  1681→	}
  1682→
  1683→	// Verify checkpoint exists
  1684→	shardedPath := ShardedCheckpointPath(checkpointID)
  1685→	metadataPath := shardedPath + "/metadata.json"
  1686→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, metadataPath) {
  1687→		t.Errorf("Checkpoint should exist at %s", metadataPath)
  1688→	} else {
  1689→		t.Log("✓ Condensation happened for commit with trailer")
  1690→	}
  1691→
  1692→	t.Log("Trailer removal opt-out test completed successfully!")
  1693→}

  1695→// TestShadow_SessionsBranchCommitTrailers verifies that commits on the entire/checkpoints/v1
  1696→// branch contain the expected trailers: Entire-Session, Entire-Strategy, and Entire-Agent.
  1697→func TestShadow_SessionsBranchCommitTrailers(t *testing.T) {
  1698→	t.Parallel()
  1699→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
  1700→	defer env.Cleanup()
  1701→
  1702→	// Setup
  1703→	env.InitRepo()

  1718→	session.CreateTranscript("Create main.go", []FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: fileContent}})
  1719→
  1720→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
  1721→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
  1722→	}
  1723→
  1724→	// Commit to trigger condensation

  1730→
  1731→	// Verify required trailers are present
  1732→	requiredTrailers := map[string]string{
  1733→		trailers.SessionTrailerKey:  "",                                // Entire-Session: <session-id>
  1734→		trailers.StrategyTrailerKey: strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit, // Entire-Strategy: manual-commit
  1735→		trailers.AgentTrailerKey:    "Claude Code",                     // Entire-Agent: Claude Code
  1736→	}
  1737→
  1738→	for trailerKey, expectedValue := range requiredTrailers {
  1739→		if !strings.Contains(sessionsCommitMsg, trailerKey+":") {
  1740→			t.Errorf("entire/checkpoints/v1 commit should have %s trailer", trailerKey)
  1741→			continue
  1742→		}
  1743→
  1744→		// If we have an expected value, verify it
  1745→		if expectedValue != "" {
  1746→			expectedTrailer := trailerKey + ": " + expectedValue
  1747→			if !strings.Contains(sessionsCommitMsg, expectedTrailer) {
  1748→				t.Errorf("entire/checkpoints/v1 commit should have %q, got message:\n%s", expectedTrailer, sessionsCommitMsg)
  1749→			} else {
  1750→				t.Logf("✓ Found trailer: %s", expectedTrailer)
  1751→			}
  1752→		} else {
  1753→			t.Logf("✓ Found trailer: %s", trailerKey)
  1754→		}
  1755→	}
  1756→
  1757→	t.Log("Sessions branch commit trailers test completed successfully!")
  1758→}

    17→// TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop tests the "commit while agent is still working" flow.
    18→//
    19→// When the user commits while the agent is in the ACTIVE phase (between
    20→// SimulateUserPromptSubmit and SimulateStop), the session should stay ACTIVE
    21→// and immediately condense. The agent continues working after the commit.
    22→// When the agent finishes its turn (SimulateStop), the session transitions to IDLE.

    24→// State machine transitions tested:

    26→//   - ACTIVE + TurnEnd -> IDLE
